featured.title: FitNambi LeagueMaster
featured.status: Live on App Store & Google Play
featured.summary: Lets sports organizers run entire leagues: teams, scoring, payments and invites, from their phone.
featured.description: A tournament management platform where organizers run complete leagues from their phone. A generic multi-sport scoring engine supports Cricket, Football and Racket Sports, with secure paid registrations through Razorpay, deep-linked team invites and push notifications, plus offline SQLite storage so venues with poor networks never lose a match. One codebase, both app stores, shipped end to end.
features: Tournament & match creation with full team/player management
Multi-sport scoring engine: Cricket, Football, Racket Sports
Secure online registrations via Razorpay
Live streaming & on-site verification flows on CameraKit
Deep-linked invites + FCM push notifications
Offline-first with SQLite for poor-network venues

featured.title: MySmartCampus ERP
featured.summary: Multi-tenant school ERP unifying admin, finance, academics, transport and communication across web and mobile.
featured.description: A multi-tenant school ERP with strict data isolation and dynamic RBAC across 30+ unified full-stack modules. The web panel covers Fees, Exams, Inventory and Timetables, while one multi-role mobile app serves Parents, Teachers, Students and Drivers. The standout engineering: a held-request location pipeline that routes live bus GPS in server memory only while a parent is actively tracking, so driver battery drain drops to zero and no location trails ever hit the database.
features: Multi-tenant architecture, 30+ modules, dynamic RBAC
Web panel: Fees, Exams, Inventory, Timetables
One app, four roles: Parents, Teachers, Students, Drivers
On-demand live bus tracking with zero location storage
Offline read-cache Axios interceptor for network loss
JWT manager with request queueing; PDFKit/ExcelJS bulk documents

featured.title: LocolDeal
featured.summary: Dual-role marketplace connecting shoppers with nearby local businesses, with built-in monetization.
featured.description: A marketplace with two sides in one app: a consumer shopping mode discovering deals from nearby businesses, and a partner mode where stores create, manage and renew coupons with registration, location management and banner uploads. Monetized through Google AdMob with dimension-locked wrappers for zero layout shift, and native Google Sign-In running inside the managed Expo workflow.
features: Dual-role ecosystem: consumer + business partner in one app
Full coupon lifecycle: claim, save, redeem in-store
Partner side: store registration, banners, renewals
Reviews & ratings for local stores
AdMob monetization with zero layout shift

featured.title: FlipReader
featured.summary: A React Native PDF reader with a fully custom native page-curl engine, deep in Swift and Kotlin.
featured.description: A PDF reader with a real page-curl animation written at the native layer: CoreGraphics on iOS Swift, and the Android PlayLikeCurl sine-wave mesh-distortion engine ported to Swift. Migrated from the classic ViewManager bridge to Nitro Modules, fully aligned with the React Native New Architecture. Windowed page rendering with aggressive caching keeps memory constant even on very large documents, and text search runs through a hidden pdfjs-dist WebView.
features: Custom native page-curl: CoreGraphics/Swift + Kotlin
Nitro Modules migration to the New Architecture
Library, bookmarks, search, zoom, text highlighting
PDF text search via hidden pdfjs-dist WebView
Windowed rendering: constant memory on huge documents

featured.title: SSAP Solar
featured.summary: Complete cross-platform ecosystem for a solar hardware business: checkout app, website, admin console and API.
featured.description: Replaced a read-only catalogue with real orders: a mobile checkout app with a 3-step flow, a public website, and a real-time admin console for inventory, leads and order states. The checkout API is idempotent per attempt so network drops can never create duplicate orders, stock decrements and order creation run inside MongoDB multi-document transactions, and every notification payload is persisted to an inbox before the ephemeral push fires, so updates are never lost.
features: 3-step mobile checkout with address & quote capture
Idempotent checkout API: no duplicate orders on network drops
MongoDB transactions around stock + order writes
Persistent notification inbox behind every push
Server-ranked Best Sellers, strict RBAC, server-side pagination

featured.title: Buckmint DEX
featured.summary: Company product: a decentralised exchange dashboard with wallet trading, portfolios and live charts.
featured.description: Core user flows for a decentralised exchange, built as founding team: MetaMask wallet connection, trading, portfolio and transaction history with token-aware TradingView charts, URL-driven pagination and token-aware formatting that loads thousands of trade records reliably. A performance overhaul replaced GIFs with Lottie, refactored SVGs into reusable components and pruned unused dependencies, cutting bundle size and load latency.
features: MetaMask wallet connection & trading flows
Token-aware TradingView charts
Portfolio + transaction history, thousands of records
Dark mode, responsive layouts
Perf overhaul: Lottie, SVG refactor, dependency pruning

featured.title: ZOOOX AI
featured.summary: Company product: consumer fintech app with AI spend analytics and a full in-app Gmail mailbox.
featured.description: Built the consumer app end to end as founding team: auth flows, deep linking, push notifications and interactive spend analytics with trend and category charts driving the cashback funnel. The standout is a Gmail OAuth integration with a custom MIME email decoding pipeline (Base64, UTF-8, quoted-printable) that renders full email content in-app like a proper mailbox. A typed GraphQL caching layer with Apollo + SWR cut redundant calls on low-end devices, and a Turborepo monorepo with shared libraries reduced duplication by about 35%.
features: Auth, deep linking, push notifications end to end
Interactive spend analytics driving the cashback funnel
Gmail OAuth + custom MIME decoding, full in-app mailbox
Apollo + SWR typed caching for low-end devices
Turborepo monorepo with shared libraries, ~35% less duplication

featured.title: Restaurant Occupancy Dashboard
featured.summary: Live operations dashboard: multi-camera HLS streaming, WebSocket occupancy and Recharts analytics.
featured.description: A live operations dashboard for restaurants: multi-camera HLS.js video streaming in-browser, WebSocket-driven table occupancy and service alerts that update instantly without reloads, and Recharts analytics for occupancy trends, sales and turnaround times. Forms are type-safe end to end with React Hook Form + Zod, auth + RBAC spans multiple staff roles across 10+ views on a Radix/shadcn component library, and managers get React Native screens on iOS and Android. Component hierarchy and state management were tuned to prevent re-renders during high-frequency WebSocket bursts.
features: Multi-camera HLS.js streaming in-browser
WebSocket table occupancy + service alerts, no reloads
Recharts analytics: occupancy, sales, turnaround
Type-safe forms, auth + RBAC across 10+ views
Manager screens in React Native for iOS & Android
